description.en:
Returns the name of the default music of the current map, read from the map's MAP_ENV data (SndBGM entry). The events use it to restart the map's music at their end.
During a match, and when the optional argument is not true, it returns instead a BGM name kept in the match state.
true to read the map's value even during a match.

Track name, e.g. "M_05".
null if the map has no default BGM, or if the script system is not ready.

examples.case: Restarting the map's music (real usage, from ev42010600.nut)
